heroImage.caption: Chief Editor — The Mirror Jammu Kashmir

body.text: Sardar Nasir Aziz Khan serves as the Chief Editor of The Mirror Jammu Kashmir, bringing decades of experience in political advocacy, human rights documentation, and international engagement.

He has represented the voice of Jammu and Kashmir at the United Nations Human Rights Council, European Parliament, and various international forums, highlighting issues of justice, dignity, and democratic rights.
As a multilingual communicator and senior spokesperson, he leads editorial direction, ensures factual accuracy, and upholds the platform’s commitment to truth and human rights.

items: Promoting democratic values and civic freedoms
Strengthening global awareness on Jammu & Kashmir

body.text: Under his leadership, The Mirror Jammu Kashmir continues to expand its global reach, providing credible reporting and in-depth analysis on regional and international developments.
